items.text:
can we start fresh, do research on github or gitlab code review interfaces. the current page is too simplistic and i want it to feel much more intuitive and fluid. in fact, i think it's ok to have some modern js tooling and importing libraries that are relevant.
some specific feedback:
- file sidebar is only a flat list, the purpose of dirs is so that we have nested navigation, _index may also be specially rendered when user clicks on the dir, instead of files.
- perhaps we can implement some search feature? the viewer doesn't have to be thin, in fact it should be rich for the reviewing purposes.
- right sidebar takes too much space, see how github or gitlab does it.
- while we can do undo operations, i also want to have delete, edit operations for the annotation, questions, comments.
- most of the times, fact files are very short, it would be great if we can have a different kind of view, for example, when clicking the dir, we will have a way to change the view, maybe display all direct child fact files as a table? so user can directly do the review decisions all in one table.
- for the decisions, i think we dont need a "Keep" decision. it should already be implied. no decision means i agree
